a diet with a high intake of whole grains, nuts, fruit, vegetables, legumes and fish, and a low intake of processed meat, sugar-sweetened beverages and red meat, could have the potential to reduce DALYs from CHD, stroke, T2D and CRC.

suboptimal food consumption in European countries was associated with a substantial proportion of DALY from CHD, stroke, T2D, and CRC, and that a single optimized TMREL could potentially be used for all four diseases.
